parquet.definition:
n. a floor made of parquetry
n. seating on the main floor between the orchestra and the parquet circle
parquet.translation:
n. 镶木地板, (剧场)正厅池座
vt. 铺镶木地板

parquet circle.translation: n. 正厅后排, 后厅; <美>（剧场的）正厅后排

parqueted.definition:
a. Formed in parquetry; inlaid with wood in small and
   differently colored figures.
parqueted.translation: v. 镶木地板( parquet的过去式 ); <美>（剧场的）正厅后排

parqueting.translation: 镶木地板( parquet的现在分词 )；<美>（剧场的）正厅后排

parquetry.definition: n. a patterned wood inlay used to cover a floor
parquetry.translation: n. 镶木细工, 镶木地板

parquets.translation: 镶木地板( parquet的第三人称单数 )；<美>（剧场的）正厅后排
